name: Leezdorf (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over light blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Leezdorf (yellow bulrushes and stars on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Leezdorf; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Leezdorf arms — bulrushes and stars on blue
